svg.title: Group record: six-word arrays in the $51538 side record
svg.desc: The side record $51538 + side*$13c holds a 4-byte queued-order header and then parallel arrays of six words, one word per group k = 0..5: group k's word n is at base + n + 2k. Two frames address it: the AI loop uses A1 = base + 2k (offset n), the executor and entity modes use the group offset D2 = side*$13c + $4c + 2k (offset n - 76). Sources: reversing/powermonger/strategy.md "`$51538` group-order table" (the n(A1) table), "Data structures (C)" (pm_side_groups), "The commander AI `$6522`" (pending word), "The game's own text: names for the fields" (aggression display only); ai.md "`$4562` how an order reaches a subordinate captain" (word 48 the sender; $6ac6 reads 48(A1) with A1 = $51538 + D2, checked by disassembly). Full list: group_soa.facts.md.
svg.text: Group fields are six-word arrays: group k's word n is at side base + n + 2k
Meaning-cell border = evidence for the field's role. Yellow column: group 2, the worked example below.
Two frames for the same word
AI loop $6564: A1 = base + D7, D7 = 2k
Header: long +0 queued flag, byte +1 type, word +2 parameter.
Trap: 30(A1) is group k+1's owner, not a field of group k;
a REPL "w" writes a longword, covering two groups' words.
<= 0: no group, the AI skips it (not the men)
$3e06 counts it to the side's eat period
target link: a lord, settlement or object
lead of the side's first group; 0 for it ($6ac6)
2 Aggressive, 3 Neutral, 4 Passive; set per AI decision
clock word at camp ($3720); waits $14 ticks
opponent or target: 2 lord, 4 group, 6 man, 8/$a animal, $c
opponent's record at the last $4bc8 ($4d6c); escort target
Cell numbers are byte offsets from the side base. +160 shows only item 0 (pike); item i's six words are at +160 + 12i .. +170 + 12i, up to +255.
Proven: the field is an input or output of $6522 (gate_cmdai.py 323/323 natural), $6ac6 (exec_census.py 44/44), $3e06 or the order senders (gate_orders.py);
aggression "display only" is a whole-image scan (py/aggr/scan_group_field.py, text segment to $1c488). Offsets are from the code, strategy.md "$51538".
+280: $c a category-4 record, 0 unset; written by $4a7a and $4bc8 (classifier $4de2); $5778 overwrites it with the attacker's offset (bug, live 1/1).
The captain panel $9090 recovers side and 2k from A3 - $51538 divided by $13c; it prints Food, Troops and the aggression line from these arrays.
